correctness.rationale: PASS. Reconstructed the unnormalized Laplacian on 01,12,23,30, unit-priced first three edges and closing price tau>0, nonnegative independent weights and total price B>0. Reflection concavity reduces maximum Fiedler value to weights (a,b,a,c); zero-sum symmetry gives even eigenvalue 2a and the odd 2x2 block [[a+2c,-a],[-a,a+2b]]. At unit gap the PSD constraints a>=1/2, U=a+2b-1>0, V=a+2c-1>0, UV>=a^2, yield cost >=(1+tau+(3-tau+2sqrt(tau))a)/2 by AM-GM. If tau<=9 the minimum at a=1/2 gives gap 4B/(5+tau+2sqrt(tau)), unique among reflection-fixed allocations when tau<9. If tau=9, equality yields the claimed interval 1/2<=a<=3/2, b=a+1/2, c=1/2-a/3 at unit gap. If tau>=9, unrestricted Rayleigh vector (-3/2,-1/2,1/2,3/2) has squared jumps 1,1,1,9 and norm^2 5; hence lambda_2<=B/5 with equality at path weights (3B/10,2B/5,3B/10,0), unique for tau>9. Closing-edge positivity for tau<9 follows strict gap increase above B/5. Independent numpy eigenspectrum and price comparisons checked 9 regimes; numerical tests only corroborate the proof.
